```{python}
#| include: false
import IPython.core.page
import matplotlib.pyplot as pl
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Create a custom function to intercept the pager
def print_page(strng, **kwargs):
    # Sometimes the pager gets a dict of mime-types, sometimes just a string
    if isinstance(strng, dict) and "text/plain" in strng:
        print(strng["text/plain"])
    else:
        print(strng)

# Override the default IPython pager globally
IPython.core.page.page = print_page
```

## Olhando na descrição do catálogo!

Note (3)  : Sources of the values are defined as follows:
- B = 	USNO-B1.0 (Monet et al., Cat. I/284)
- C = 	UCAC2 (Zacharias et al., Cat. I/289)
- M = 	2MASS catalog of point sources (Cutri et al., Cat. II/246)
- Y = 	YB6 Catalog (USNO, unpublished)
- T = 	Tycho-2 Catalog (Hog et al., 2000, Cat. I/259)
- H = 	Hipparcos catalog (Table I/239/hip_main)
- o = 	Palomar-I blue (O) plate (for Bmag)
- e = 	Palomar-I red (E) plate (for Rmag)
